preconditions.expression: all(x in 'abc' for x in input)
preconditions.description: The input string contains only characters a, b, and/or c.

postconditions.expression: output == ''.join([('b' if x == 'a' else ('a' if x == 'b' else 'c')) for x in input])
postconditions.description: Each character in the input string is switched as follows: a becomes b, b becomes a, and c remains c.
